description: Diagnoses a checkout incident. Returns the current error rate, total and error request counts, and the failing dependency over the last 5 minutes. Call this first when investigating a checkout SLO burn.

configuration.query: FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE span.name == "POST /checkout" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 5 minutes | STATS total = COUNT(*), errors = COUNT(*) WHERE status.code == "Error" | EVAL error_rate = ROUND(errors::double / total, 4) | EVAL failing_dependency = "quote"
